zh-CN.name: 蒸汽波
zh-CN.description: 以怀旧数字媒介意象、粉紫或青色调、网格与拼贴表现疏离的复古氛围。它是宽泛审美方向，不能把风格化噪点、失真与低对比强加给功能文本。
use_when: 音乐、活动或作品展示需要特定的怀旧情绪。
有合适素材与明确的版权来源。
avoid_when: 不要使用失真字体展示关键说明或操作标签。
避免无必要的闪烁与持续噪点动画。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 在封面与背景使用受控的怀旧数字拼贴和粉紫青色调，正文放在稳定的高对比表面；功能入口清楚可辨；噪点和失真仅作有限装饰，减少动态效果时移除非必要动画。

en.name: Vaporwave
en.description: A broad aesthetic using nostalgic digital imagery, pink-purple or cyan tones, grids and collage for a detached retro atmosphere. Stylized noise, distortion and low contrast should not be imposed on functional text.
use_when: Music, campaigns or portfolios need a specific nostalgic atmosphere.
Suitable imagery has clear usage rights.
avoid_when: Do not use distorted typography for essential instructions or action labels.
Avoid unnecessary flicker and continuous animated noise.
en.prompt_template: Use controlled retro digital collage and pink-purple-cyan tones in covers or backgrounds. Place body text on stable high-contrast surfaces and keep actions recognizable. Limit noise and distortion to decoration, removing nonessential animation when motion is reduced.
